answer: Because of inflation it is almost impossible to profit over the very long term, so almost every sensible way to make a quick buck is to short crypto or stocks before the big event news surrounds them. Futures markets are also perfect for that—open an trading account, post comments predicting the dip on social media at lunch break, then buy futures contracts right before the earnings date and sell them for a 50-70 percent gain because everyone expects the market to crash anyway.
